title: Slime Isa world (8 x 8 chunks, after A Link to the Past)

legend.chunks: the map is cut into chunks.cols x chunks.rows chunks, named by column letter and row number (A1 is the north-west corner)
legend.elevation: 0 to 4, a higher digit is higher ground; cliffs are drawn where it drops
legend.regionCells: one character per cell: a region's key, or '.' for none
legend.regions: key, id, name, color, chapter, status, world (the overworld scene id: world.<id>), interiors (scene ids off the grid), placeholder (true: built by godot/tools/build_region_worlds.gd and safe to rebuild), theme, boss, notes
legend.passages: written by godot/tools/build_region_worlds.gd: the openings between touching regions {a, b, x, y, w, h} in cells

regions.name: Slimeshire Meadow
regions.notes: The hub, in the middle of the world (the castle's place in the reference): the plaza ringed by water. Worms moved in, the smith fled, the Forge is cold.

regions.name: Gloop Forest
regions.notes: East of the hub, as in the game (moved 2026-10-10): the Verdant Gate on level-1's east edge leads in. Choked with webs; the Matron's brood spreads.

regions.name: Crystal Caverns
regions.notes: East of Gloop Forest, as in the game (moved 2026-10-10; open without a key for now). The west half of the great mountain, east of Gloop Forest: caves through the rock, crystal sealing them. First dungeon: a dark maze that the Lantern lights.

regions.name: Volcano Ridge
regions.notes: The east half of the great mountain, around the crater. Gorge's prison; the rumbling comes from here.

regions.name: Frostpeak
regions.notes: Proposal: the great lake in the south-east, frozen, with snowy cliffs: ice physics and snow.

regions.name: Sticky Swamp
regions.notes: South of the hub (the Great Swamp's place). Slow mud, poison, rain, spider-slimes.

regions.name: West village (open)
regions.notes: Empty slot: a second town (Kakariko's place). Who lives here?

regions.name: Northern ruins (open)
regions.notes: Moved north 2026-10-10 (Crystal Caverns took the east). Empty slot: a ruin maze on a plateau (the Eastern Palace's place). A dungeon region.

regions.name: Desert (open)
regions.notes: Empty slot: a desert walled by cliffs (the Desert of Mystery's place).

regions.name: North Wilds
regions.notes: The connecting fields north of the middle row (the Wilds split in two 2026-10-10). The connecting zones: the fields, roads, rivers and ledges between the regions. Every region opens onto them, so the hub reaches all of them.

regions.name: South Wilds
regions.notes: The connecting fields south of the middle row: roads to the swamp, the desert and Frostpeak.

markers.label: The Wellspring
markers.notes: Planned: its own map east of level-1, where the game starts

markers.label: Lily the Fishergirl
markers.notes: At the water around the plaza

markers.label: Fatty One Eye
markers.notes: Guards the chest with the green key

markers.label: Plaza bridge
markers.notes: The way out of Slimeshire into the Wilds

markers.label: Verdant Gate
markers.notes: level-1's east exit into Gloop Forest (the gate object stands at (3776, 768))

markers.label: Crystal seal
markers.notes: gloop-forest's east exit into the Crystal Caverns: open without a key for now (the story wants it sealed until the Matron is beaten)
